claims.summary: The roadmap commits the next architecture lane to CourseIR-first generation: a dense validated course source of truth before deterministic package compilation.
The design rejects one giant final-prose response and instead specifies compact semantic atoms for the model to return.
The roadmap defines model-capacity planning by input context, output cap, reliability reserve, and cost, choosing whole-course IR or fewest-call sharding per model.
The compiler contract requires deterministic artifact expansion from CourseIR, schema validation, coverage checks, and path-scoped repair instead of blind regeneration.
The roadmap defines the CourseIR proof ladder before implementation: flagged 5-, 8-, and 15-lesson side-by-side audits comparing calls, cost, grader findings, digest caveats, and export parity.

carryForward.next: Implement the first flagged CourseIR vertical slice: schema, capacity planner, one generation path, one compiler adapter, and side-by-side proof.
